annotations.title: FDA NDC marketing status (active / ending / discontinued)

description: FDA NDC marketing status (active / ending / discontinued) — Is this NDC still marketed? Looks up a package NDC (0002-3227-30, 11-digit 00002322730, or 10-digit) or every package of a product NDC (0002-3227) in FDA's NSDE file, which unlike the active NDC directory keeps discontinued packages. Returns per-package marketing start/end dates, inactivation/reactivation dates, billing unit (EA/ML/GM), marketing category, application number and a status: ACTIVE, ENDING (future end date = planned discontinuation), DISCONTINUED or INACTIVE, plus an overall verdict (PARTIAL when a product mixes active and discontinued packages). Not found = 404 (not charged). Source: openFDA NSDE, public domain. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: fda_ndc_status
